name: Filament Finance
technique: Order Book Price Manipulation; Self-Liquidation Abuse; Sybil Attack
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.76). Replaced keyword guess "oracle-manipulation".
rootCause: On April 6, 2025, Filament Finance, an order book DEX on Sei, was exploited for approximately $572,000. The attacker used multiple accounts to spoof order book prices, opened leveraged positions, and strategically self-liquidated these positions to drain most protocol funds. Filament Finance relied on thinly traded order book pricing without circuit breakers or Sybil/multi-account defenses. The design allowed coordinated actors to spoof prices, trigger self-liquidations at manipulated prices, and drain user assets without detection.
